subject: CloudPO SKU phasing & partner netting (AWS private offer)
body:
From: Sam Lowell <sam.lowell@cloudbridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud marketplace PO — initial SKU phasing & partner margin question

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and our channel team are preparing an AWS private offer and have a couple of constraints we wanted to check on before we formalize the PO:

- We have 12 SKUs (metered by token/hour combinations). We want to phase the SKUs across three delivery waves (MVP -> Scale -> Add-ons). Does Redwood support a private offer that anchors an initial list price, then enables progressive discounts per wave?
- Channel margin: our reseller partner expects a 10% commission on net billings. Is that pass-throughable at the private offer level, or does Redwood require the margin to be handled off-invoice?
- We may need an early-adopter credit for the first 6 months for two tier-1 SKUs—do you support limited-term crediting against committed usage?

Attaching our requirements doc (cloudbridge_pricing_requirements.pdf). Can you confirm design constraints and any docs we should prep for marketplace submission?

Best,
Sam
Sam Lowell
Head of Cloud Partnerships, CloudBridge

----------------------------------------
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lowell <sam.lowell@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace PO — initial SKU phasing & partner margin question

Sam — thanks for the clear brief and the attachment. Short answers up front, then a proposed approach.

TL;DR: Yes — we can support a phased SKU rollout in a single private offer. We recommend anchoring at your target list prices and expressing wave discounts as scheduled percentage markdowns tied to the same PO. Channel margin is best handled as an off-invoice reseller commission (i.e., Redwood invoices the committed list price, partner receives commission separately). We can support a limited-term early-adopter credit applied as a contra-usage credit for the first N months.

Proposed approach (high level):
- Single AWS private offer containing all SKUs. 
  - Phase tags on SKU lines: Phase 1 (MVP) — 4 SKUs, Phase 2 (Scale) — next 5 SKUs, Phase 3 (Add-ons) — remaining 3 SKUs.
  - Anchor list price applied at creation; discounts schedule applied by effective date per phase.
- Channel margin: we recommend a two-line approach in the commercial docs:
  1) Redwood retail list price on the PO
  2) Reseller commission arrangement (off-invoice) to be handled between CloudBridge and your partner — we will provide a standard commission confirmation letter for signing.
- Early-adopter credit: we can put a time-bound credit that reduces invoiceable usage for specific SKU ids for the first 90/180 days.

Open items we need from you to finalize the PO:
1) Confirm expected committed MAU/usage per SKU by phase (gives us the right buckets).
2) Confirm whether the partner commission should be calculated on net-of-credits or gross billings. Our default is gross billings (commission paid on list price), but we can change to net if you prefer.
3) Specify whether you want incremental roll-forward of discounts or a one-time price ladder.

I attached an initial pricing proposal (initial_pricing_proposal.xlsx) and a short PDF summary (redwood_sku_phase_summary.pdf) showing the proposed phase dates and mechanics.

If it helps, can we schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to align and lock the structure?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: initial_pricing_proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_sku_phase_summary.pdf (pdf)

----------------------------------------
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace PO — internal margin question

Quick internal note before we lock the external language. A couple of points for ops/accounting:
- If CloudBridge wants the 10% commission on net billings (after credits), that reduces our recognized revenue; need to confirm how they want to structure (gross vs net).
- Marketplace pass-through mechanics matter: some clouds force commissions/gross adjustments to reconcile via marketplace settlements — that can introduce lag in our cashflow. Ops will want us to prefer off-invoice payables from the partner where possible.
- Also flag: early-adopter credits applied as contra-usage will reduce metered revenue in month-of-invoice; make sure finance signs off.

Recommend we propose: 8% reseller commission on gross billings + 2% administrative passback (total 10%), with the administrative passback to be treated as a partner payout (off-invoice). That keeps Redwood revenue predictable and gives CloudBridge the net economics they want.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

----------------------------------------
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace PO — channel split suggestion

Agree with Ben's recommendation and a few execution notes:
- Proposed split: 8% reseller commission (calculated on list price), 2% handling/ops passback (separately payable) — communicates a clean 10% margin to the partner.
- Early-adopter credit: offer a 12-month decaying credit: 20% off on two anchor SKUs for months 1-3, 10% months 4-6, 5% months 7-12. Apply as invoice-level credit items labeled "Early Adopter Credit - SKU-XXX" so CloudBridge can present finance-friendly line items to their partner.
- SKU phasing: recommend Phase 1 activation window 2027-11-01 to 2028-01-31; Phase 2: 2028-02-01 to 2028-06-30; Phase 3: 2028-07-01 onwards.

If everyone is ok, I can turn this into the formal commercial language and draft the commission confirmation letter. Also propose we include a proforma DocuSign for the PO so procurement can route internal approvals.

- Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

----------------------------------------
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lowell <sam.lowell@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 16:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace PO — confirmation and next steps

Sam — thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. Below is the proposed commercial structure for the AWS private offer and the channel mechanics. If this looks good, please confirm and we will convert to a PO + DocuSign proforma.

Proposed commercial summary (final draft):
- Offer vehicle: Single AWS private offer containing all 12 SKUs with phase tags (Phase 1/2/3).
- Pricing model: Anchor list price per SKU at creation; discounts applied on effective dates per phase.
- Phase windows: Phase 1: 2027-11-01 -> 2028-01-31; Phase 2: 2028-02-01 -> 2028-06-30; Phase 3 starts 2028-07-01.
- Channel margin: 8% reseller commission calculated on list price (Redwood issues invoices on list price). Additional 2% administrative passback payable from CloudBridge to partner (off-invoice). We will provide a commission confirmation letter outlining these mechanics for signatures.
- Early-adopter credit: Defined for two anchor SKUs with a 12-month decaying schedule (20% M1-3, 10% M4-6, 5% M7-12). Credits applied as invoice-line contra-usage items.
- Billing & recognition: Redwood invoices based on usage at list price less contractual discounts. Partner commission settlement handled off-invoice as agreed between CloudBridge and its reseller.

Next steps:
1) Sam: confirm acceptance of the above channel split (8% commission + 2% passback) and phase windows.
2) CloudBridge: send estimated committed usage buckets per SKU for each phase (spreadsheet preferred).
3) We will publish a private offer draft and send a DocuSign proforma for signature (link included below).

Attachments: redwood_sku_phase_summary.pdf, docusign_proforma.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7421/CB-2027-1102
DocuSign (proforma): https://docusign.com/secure/ENVELOPEID-93jf83k

If you'd like, we can hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk procurement through the DocuSign flow.

Looking forward — please reply with a quick confirm and we will move the PO to draft.

Mina Haddad
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
